entry.title: Trump engineered a risky comeback for Jensen Huang
entry.summary: After Nvidia's board accepted Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO, following reports that Huang had an affair with an alleged Chinese spy, President Donald Trump, too, appeared to submit to the new reality. Appearing on Stephen A. Smith's radio show shortly after the news came out, Trump said that Huang would "end up on his feet." […]
